verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents several REST APIs (HTTP V2, Dashboard REST, export, cohorts), and a probe found a machine-readable openapi.json. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples such as a try-it console or executable request samples. A raw OpenAPI spec and static endpoint descriptions are building blocks or adjacent material, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
